intentEvidence: This plugin places the full Markdown of a source block between invisible HTML comment markers in every referencing note.
motivation: Embedded blocks are useful outside of Obsidian if notes are self-contained.
problem: Native block embeds are often just links or strings that external tools (like LLMs) cannot resolve or render as complete text.
summary: Full Block Embed allows users to embed the complete Markdown content of a source block into other notes while keeping all copies synchronized.
